name: Mindgrasp
summary: Summaries, notes and quizzes generated from your course material.
description: Mindgrasp turns lecture videos, PDFs, recordings and web pages into notes, summaries, flashcards and quizzes. You can also ask questions about your material to study.
features: Mindgrasp is an AI product for education.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Mindgrasp
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Mindgrasp est un produit d'IA destiné à l'éducation.
summary_fr: Résumés, notes et quiz générés à partir de tes cours.
description_fr: Mindgrasp transforme vidéos de cours, PDF, enregistrements et pages web en notes, résumés, flashcards et quiz. On peut aussi poser des questions sur ses supports pour réviser.
